Our Mission

To make work better for frontline teams.

Frontline employees are at the heart of some of the world’s biggest brands. They’re the people serving customers, running stores and bringing those brands to life every day, but they haven’t always had the same access to great technology as people working behind a desk.

We want to change that.

YOOBIC gives frontline teams the tools, information and support they need to do their best work, while helping businesses stay connected, move faster and perform better across every location.

It’s a simple mission, but a big one: to help millions of frontline employees have a better day at work.

Who are we?

We’re transforming how the world’s best retailers perform.

YOOBIC is the leading AI-powered retail operations platform, helping the world’s biggest brands turn strategy into action across every store, every day.

Retail moves fast. Thousands of decisions, tasks and interactions happen on the frontline every day — and the difference between good execution and great execution has a direct impact on performance.

That’s where YOOBIC comes in.

Our platform brings AI, automation, analytics, task management, communications and learning together in one place, giving frontline teams the tools and intelligence they need to perform at their best. From helping a store manager identify their biggest sales opportunity that morning, to enabling HQ teams to execute flawlessly across thousands of locations, we help retailers turn insight into action at scale.

Today, 350+ global retail brands trust YOOBIC to power their frontline operations. And we're continuing to push the category forward, embedding AI deeper into the everyday experience of store teams and managers through products like Store Manager Copilot, AI Assistant and AI-powered visual compliance.

We’ve built something big. Now we’re scaling it.

Founded in 2014, YOOBIC has grown from an ambitious idea into a global technology company with teams across London, New York, Paris and Tel Aviv, backed by leading investors including Insight Partners, Highland Europe and Felix Capital.

But what makes this an exciting time to join isn't where we've been. It's where we're going.

AI is fundamentally changing how retailers operate, and YOOBIC is building at the centre of that transformation. We’re expanding our platform, deepening our AI capabilities and growing our presence with some of the world’s most recognised brands.

For our GTM teams, that means a serious opportunity: a proven product, an enormous market and a category that is evolving fast.

We’re looking for ambitious people who want to build, move quickly and make an impact, whether that's opening new markets, winning and growing global customers, creating demand or building partnerships that accelerate our growth.

If you want to help shape the next chapter of a global SaaS business, not just join one, you’ll feel at home here at YOOBIC.

Why YOOBIC?

Come for the opportunity. Stay for the people.

We’re ambitious about what we’re building, but we know how we get there matters just as much.

At YOOBIC, you’ll work with smart, driven people who care about what they do, support each other and aren’t afraid to roll up their sleeves. We move quickly, give people real ownership and encourage everyone to bring their ideas to the table, whatever their role or level.

There’s no single path to success here. We want you to be curious, take initiative, try things, learn from what doesn’t work and make your mark as we grow.

What you can expect

  • Real ownership - the freedom and trust to make decisions, take initiative and have a visible impact.

  • Plenty of opportunity - we’re growing, which means new challenges, bigger responsibilities and space to shape your own path.

  • Great people - ambitious, down-to-earth colleagues who care about doing great work without taking themselves too seriously.

  • A genuinely international team - work with people, customers and partners from different countries, cultures and perspectives every day.

  • A fast-moving environment - things change, ideas become action quickly and there’s always something new to learn.

  • A place where you can be yourself - we want people to feel welcome, supported and able to do their best work.

If you like having ownership, moving at pace and being surrounded by people who want to build something great, you’ll fit right in.

Our Benefits & Perks

We really believe in the wellness our team at YOOBIC and are proud to offer an attractive mix of healthcare benefits and perks that meet the needs of our global employees and their families, no matter their stage in life. 

This includes a variety of personalised healthcare and well-being resources so that you have the peace of mind. We are also proud to offer various wellness perks, including mental health support, online workouts and of course, a flexible working environment (role dependant)

What we promise

This is what you can expect being part of the amazing team at YOOBIC:

  • A dynamic environment
  • A team of seasoned pro’s
  • Continuous growth and learning
  • An open feedback culture
  • Lots of room for your own initiatives and ideas
  • Transparency on results and strategy
  • 'Open door' policy with our leadership team
  • Team spirit and dedication
  • Recognition and rewards for hard work
  • And most importantly, we will challenge and motivate you so that you can reach your full potential

Meet the Founders

In 2014, 3 brothers - Fabrice, Avi and Gilles Haïat - saw a gap in the market and created a product that sought to empower and engage frontline workforces across the globe. That's how YOOBIC was born.

Prior to their most recent endeavour, the brothers co-founded Vizelia, a pioneering energy monitoring solution that they built and sold to Schneider Electric in 2011.

They've spent the last 15+ years envisioning and developing industry-disrupting technologies, and we are all excited to be on this journey with YOOBIC to redefine the #futureofwork
